title: Crispy Fish Tacos
steps:
Salt + lime on the fish.
Pan-fry 4 min a side
until crispy

Sour cream + lime juice
+ pinch of salt
= lime crema

Warm tortillas.
Everyone builds
their own
vo: Crispy fish tacos, thirty minutes, and the kids build their own.
Crispy fish tacos with lime crema.
You need tilapia, corn tortillas, limes, sour cream and shredded cabbage.
Season the fish with salt and lime, then pan-fry it four minutes a side until crispy.
Stir sour cream with lime juice and a pinch of salt. That's your crema.
Warm the tortillas, then set out the fish, cabbage and crema so everyone builds their own.
